description: Update an agent (partial): name, description, color, active, trigger_mode, run_every_minutes, and the profile — persona, values, autonomy, fast_model, deliberate_model (unknown fields such as slug are rejected with a hint, not dropped). trigger_mode decides WHO runs this agent: "mcp_client" (default) means it only ever runs while an MCP client drives it — close the client and nothing happens, however many recurring tasks point at it. "server_job" means the server triggers it on its own clock and therefore needs run_every_minutes (e.g. 1440 for daily); switching without a cadence is refused rather than silently doing nothing. Switching is reversible and changes NOTHING about the agent's tool permissions — tools that need approval still need it. WHEN it may run: run_from/run_to ("08:00"/"20:00", empty string removes the limit), run_days (1=Monday .. 7=Sunday, also "1-5" or "mo-fr") and timezone (IANA, e.g. Europe/Berlin — the agent's own, not the tenant's). A run falling due outside the window is SKIPPED, not caught up: the next date moves to the next opening, so a weekend does not produce sixteen runs on Monday morning.

agent_id.description: ID of the agent to change

autonomy.description: How freely the agent acts: autonomous, approval (default) or read_only

deliberate_model.description: Model for slower, more careful reasoning steps of this agent

fast_model.description: Model for quick, routine steps of this agent

grund.description: Why this change (goes into the optimisation register, list_optimierungen)

persona.description: Who the agent is, in its own words

run_every_minutes.description: Run cadence in minutes for server_job agents, e.g. 1440 for daily

run_from.description: Earliest local time of day, e.g. 08:00

run_to.description: Latest local time of day, e.g. 20:00

timezone.description: IANA zone the agent works in

trigger_mode.description: Who runs the agent: mcp_client (default, only while a client drives it) or server_job (server schedule)

values.description: The agent's rules (shown as identity.values in get_agent_bootstrap)

name: update_agent
